step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows two main environments separated by VPC Peering: AWS Data on the left and AWS User/Processing on the right. External users upload files directly to an S3 bucket in the User/Processing account. An S3 event triggers a message in SQS, which is read by EKS and Auto Scaling Groups (EC2) to execute processing tasks. On the data side, S3 stores core datasets which are served through EKS via VPC Peering to the user-facing processing EKS cluster.
